# Do it live

> Vibe presenting: a presentation with no deck. The speaker presses the mic and talks, and the slides draw themselves while they speak. Free in any browser at https://doitlive.app, open source under the MIT license, built on NVIDIA Nemotron models via Nebius Token Factory.

Do it live listens to a talk and decides, every few spoken words, whether the moment deserves a slide. When it does, the slide appears mid-sentence. The speaker never builds a slide.

A slide can be:

- a drawing that builds on screen while it is written;
- one of 60 large interface elements: a login that folds away, a poll, a declined card, a text message, a failing terminal;
- a figure read from the speaker's own words: "from 12 to 700" becomes a change with its factor, "one in five" a row of figures with one lit;
- a duel between two things, moving type, a question left hanging, or the speaker quoted back;
- one of the speaker's own GIFs, photos or clips, shown when it fits what is being said;
- a sourced fact, with its source on the slide, when the speaker asks the room a question with a number in it;
- one of 80 wordless animated scenes when nothing else fits.

Every slide comes in one of seven looks, chosen like a presentation theme: Scribble (marker on a whiteboard, the default), Pop, Signal, Redacted, Broadcast, Sticker and Scoreboard.

## Using it

- Open https://doitlive.app in Google Chrome, Edge or Safari, on a laptop or a phone with a microphone. No account and no password.
- Each visitor gets 15 free minutes of stage time a day.
- Speech in English or Swedish.
- On a phone, Screen turns the phone into the audience screen: plug it into a TV and talk.
- No microphone? "Play the demo talk" replays a scripted talk.
- A slide shows a number only if the speaker said it or a cited source gave it. Numbers are never invented.

## How it is built

- Next.js app on Vercel. A stage engine in the browser reads the live transcript and decides when to ask for a slide.
- Speech to text: AssemblyAI streaming.
- Director: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning on Nebius Token Factory decides show or hold, and which layout.
- Drawer: a race between Kimi-K3, gpt-oss-120b and NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra. The first model to answer streams its drawing as HTML and CSS into a sandboxed frame.
- Own media: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL watches frames of each GIF, Tavily finds what the internet calls it, and Qwen3 Embedding ranks the library against what is being said.
- Facts: Tavily search plus NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra make one slide that shows its source.
